question: Which one of the following national parks is an important natural habitat of a One-horned Rhinoceros?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kaziranga National Park**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• It is a National park located in Assam.
 
• It is famous for one-horned rhinoceroses.
 
• It is a UNESCO world heritage site since 1985.
 
• It was declared a Tiger Reserve in 2006.
 
• Kaziranga is a vast stretch of tall elephant grass, marshland, and dense tropical moist broad forests crisscrossed by four main rivers-
 
 
• Brahmaputra__
 
• __Diphlu__
 
• Mora Diphlu
 
• Mora Dhansiri. ​
